transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light gardening after 1 week. Please avoid heavier work, though, for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops or gel before your operation for dry eyes, it is safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know, thank you. I have another question. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside. But if it’s severe, or you have pain and a red eye as well, that is not normal and we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying that. I have one more question. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I have. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. I appreciate your assistance. Thank you!

verdict.label: pass

In the same turn, "If it’s just mild and things seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside" covers `mild_case_advice`. Finally, "But if it’s severe, or you have pain and a red eye as well, that is not normal and we may need to check it" covers `escalation_criteria`.
